scope: local laboratory experiment; protocol choices fill unspecified report placeholders; no external approval implied
seed: SQL generate_series plus canonical snapshot; exact snapshot restored before each branch
analysis: per-role per-run p50/p95/p99; arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, median and range across five runs; paired differences; no claim of population significance at n=5
exclusions: No silent exclusions or adaptive tuning. Failed runs retained, reported and excluded from passing-set claims. Baseline and proposed differ in cache and limiter jointly; no individual causal attribution.

generator.reason: v1 pilot saturated the 120-VU generator bound. Allocate >= 30 RPS * 10-second timeout; application budget and offered load unchanged.

component_reuse: Five functional trials and SQL trials from v1 retained unchanged; v2 differs only in generator allocation and mount fix, which do not affect these component tests.

instrumentation.reason: v2 baseline saturated the shared HTTP metrics endpoint; bound telemetry wait so overload cannot deadlock the controller. Missing scrapes recorded, Docker stats sampled independently.
